object_description: compact gable-roofed volume with a minimal footprint
design_condition: The school is placed eccentrically to the west, reinforcing the boundary between the village and agricultural land while opening a vast outdoor space and extending a pedestrian path into the site.

positive.statement: The project has great accuracy in its consideration of the site and its landscape and urban-planning qualities.
The simple volume with a gable roof integrates into the traditional farms and villa district as a house or barn among others.
The facade expression lightens the volume and controls its scale through alternating opaque and transparent elements.
The compact building and minimal footprint protect the land and facilitate the expected extension.
The rational plan typology suggests good economics for the project.

negative.statement: The central corridor system is effective but generates an extremely simple, even banal, spatiality.
The interior staircase is weak: entering under it is unpleasant and the direction of movement upstairs is not sufficiently direct.
The social and spatial added value of the primary-school circulation space remains questionable.
